meta.name: customize-opencode
meta.description: Customize opencode configuration, theme, keybindings, and agent settings. Use when modifying dreamcode/opencode behavior, adding custom agents, or adjusting system preferences.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调整编码工具的主题、快捷键和智能助手设置。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想按自己的习惯定制编码工具的外观和操作方式。
copy.tagline_en: Customize your coding tool's theme, keyboard shortcuts, and agent settings.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to tailor your coding tool's look and feel.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你修改 opencode 的配置文件、主题、快捷键和 agent 设置;改前先备份,改后逐步验证,确保原有功能不受影响。
howto.when: 当你提出要修改 opencode 的行为、添加自定义 agent 或工具,或调整键位、主题、模型等设置时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 opencode 主题改成深色系。
say.note: 会先备份配置,只改主题相关设置。

say.text: 给 opencode 添加一个自定义 agent 处理代码审查。
say.note: 会修改 agent 配置并验证不影响现有工作流。

say.text: 把快捷键改成 Vim 风格。
say.note: 会增量修改键位配置并测试。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude will help modify opencode config files, themes, keybindings, and agent settings. It backs up existing config before changes, tests incrementally, and verifies existing workflows still work.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to modify opencode behavior, add custom agents or tools, or adjust keybindings, theme, model settings, etc.

say_en.text: Change the opencode theme to a dark one.
say_en.note: It backs up config first and only changes theme settings.

say_en.text: Add a custom agent for code review to opencode.
say_en.note: It updates agent config and verifies existing workflows.
It incrementally modifies keybindings and tests.
